sources: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping (read in a browser; the Campground Amenities, Camping Fees and Campground Rules panels)
https://www.broward.org/parks/Fees (Camping section, 'Updated Dec 29, 2025', read in a browser)

values.note: Broward County fee schedule (updated 2025-12-29, 'All fees are subject to change'): $50 per site per night plus tax, including park admission and dump-station use; pets $5 per pet per night (plus a $50 pet deposit); veterans $30 a night in November. Stays under 14 days are prepaid in full.

fees.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/Fees (Camping: 'a. Site Fee Includes park admission fee and use of sanitary dump stations where available. 1. Per Site, Per Night $50', 'Pet Fee, per pet, per night $5', 'Veterans Rate (November), per site, per night $30'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping ('T.Y. (Topeekeegee Yugnee) Park (954-357-8811; TYPark@Broward.org; 61 full hook-up RV sites)') + https://www.broward.org/parks/Fees ('The campgrounds at C.B. Smith and T.Y. are open to RVs with full hookups only that must be connected to the park's sewage system'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: RVs only: no tents, and cassette toilets or portable wastewater tanks are not allowed. Up to eight people per site.

sites.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping ('61 full hook-up RV sites'; Campground Rules: 'A maximum of eight people is permitted per campsite') + https://www.broward.org/parks/Fees ('Cassette-type toilets and transportable wastewater containers are not permitted'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: T.Y. Park's restrooms are air-conditioned. Wi-Fi only at locations the park office gives. Washer $2 a load, dryer $1.

facilities.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping (Campground Amenities: 'Restroom complexes with hot showers (T.Y. Park restrooms are also air-conditioned)', 'Sanitary dumpstations', 'Wi-Fi access (check with Park Office for access locations)', 'Laundry rooms (C.B. Smith, Easterlin, and T.Y. park campgrounds only)') + https://www.broward.org/parks/Fees ('Washer use, per load $2', 'Dryer use, per cycle $1'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping ('The campgrounds at C.B. Smith Park ..., Easterlin ..., Markham Park ..., and T.Y. (Topeekeegee Yugnee) Park ... are open year-round'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Campground reservations must be made by calling or emailing the park office directly' (954-357-8811, TYPark@Broward.org; office 9-5 daily); payment only at the park office or Pay Online. Extended RV stays up to 180 days in a 365-day period. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m. Cancelling 5 days or less ahead costs the nightly fee for up to five nights.

booking.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping ('Campground reservations must be made by calling or emailing the park office directly'; Campground Rules: 'Extended-stay RV campgrounds allow a maximum stay of 180 days within a 365-day period', 'Check-in begins at 3PM ... Check-out is no later than 1PM') + https://www.broward.org/parks/Fees ('extended stays are allowed for up to 180 days for RV sites'; cancellation fees), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Veterans pay $30 a night in November (the regular site fee is $50).

discounts.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/Fees ('Veterans Rate (November), per site, per night $30'), read 2026-10-21

note: Broward County Parks campground (Whispering Pines) in 138-acre T.Y. Park, Hollywood, with paved sites. --Claude
summary: Broward County's camping and fee pages: $50/site/night (2025-12 schedule, incl. admission), 61 full-hookup RV sites (was 60), open year-round, showers/dump/laundry/Wi-Fi, reserve by phone or email to the park office, 180-night max, veterans $30 in November. Electric amperage not stated (derived 50 left). Note: dropped the site/hookup/facility/booking and RV Life text.

Stale website: https://www.broward.org/Parks/pages/park.aspx?park=37 now redirects to the Broward Parks home page. The county's camping page is https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping.
